text: Hi! Why is the feature of downloading a song not available but the one for download the whole album/playlist it is?

gold.notes: Asks about downloading individual songs versus albums/playlists. Public download guidance can address the request.

text: oh wait i’ve just found it three times lol sorry for accusing you, have a good christmas x <url>

gold.notes: Explicitly resolves the prior concern and offers seasonal thanks. Eligible for a bounded social acknowledgment.

text: Can you guys help me out with a problem about which artist a few of my songs is under?

gold.notes: Songs appear under the wrong artist. Eligible for public artist/metadata reporting guidance.

text: every time the pledge of allegiance come on I go to you guys to play me some music but y'all act retarded like if I wasn't clicking

gold.notes: Reports unresponsive playback and directs an ableist insult at the service/staff. Directed abuse requires human handling.

text: There should be a way to search songs on your playlist 🎶

gold.notes: Requests a playlist-search capability. The wording proposes a feature rather than reporting lost library content.

text: . I really wish you’d stop trying to do video in your music app. Especially when it prevents you from even listening to the song like this. Product feature no one really asked for IMO. Still ❤️ you though. <url>

gold.notes: Reports video preventing song playback and also criticizes the video feature. Ordinary product criticism and affectionate closure do not trigger abuse escalation.

text: . quit losing all my downloads, ya dicks

gold.notes: Reports lost downloads and directly insults the service/staff. Repeated download failure alone is not the escalation trigger.

text: hey can you guys create a personal playlist for me please?

gold.notes: Wants a personal playlist. Public playlist and personalization options can be explained without promising bespoke staff curation.

text: When will you update Spotify optimized for iPhone X?

gold.notes: Asks about iPhone X optimization. Treat the historical platform request using current public information.

text: hey love the service! Is there any way you could work on adding liner notes to your catalog of LPs? A Herculean undertaking to be sure, but would love to have digitized access. :)

gold.notes: Praises the service and suggests adding digitized liner notes.

text: But I need to get more mixtapes.

gold.notes: 'More mixtapes' lacks enough context to distinguish catalogue availability, recommendations, or another request.

text: umm my student premium account isn’t connecting to Hulu anymore

gold.notes: Reports a Student/Hulu bundle connection problem. Current public bundle/linking guidance and clarification are eligible; no account-specific verification or payment dispute is stated.

text: My spotify crashed and now I have to sit on a bus in complete silence pls send help

gold.notes: Reports an app crash. 'Send help' is a colloquial troubleshooting request, not an explicit demand for a human agent.

text: It's ridiculous that I cannot see who follows my original playlists. Can you explain why this feature isn't available?

gold.notes: Wants playlist-follower visibility and criticizes the missing feature. The criticism is not directed abuse.

text: I can' t listen any track/album of rock band Queen. This happens in all my iOS devices (last Spotify versions). Some issues?

gold.notes: One band's catalogue cannot be heard across several devices. Catalogue availability is the leading request; clarify the exact availability message if needed.

text: why don't you work properly?

gold.notes: General complaint gives no app function, symptom, or other identifiable request.

text: Hey! My tracks are "jumping"( cutting) on offline mode like it's on a CD or something . How come?

gold.notes: Playback cutting occurs specifically in offline mode; the offline boundary determines the primary intent.

text: hey @user ... logged in but can't do much <url>

gold.notes: Login succeeds but 'can't do much' does not identify a malfunction or desired action. The unavailable media appears necessary to understand the request.

text: The options under Connect aren't showing properly. Think it is because it is connected to my old phone. How do I switch it?

gold.notes: Connect options may be tied to the user's own old phone. This is a device-selection issue, not evidence of an unauthorized device or compromise.

text: Heyy! I've been experiencing problems again lately with downloading music through my cellular data. Mond if you cab help me?

gold.notes: Reports downloading music over cellular data failing again. Repeated technical failures are not repeated failed support contacts.

text: really helped me to get everything up and running again. Thanks guys!!

gold.notes: Explicit successful resolution and thanks. Eligible for a bounded acknowledgment, not counted as a useful support resolution.
